in_marathi.name: Debajyoti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's day, God's victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Debajyoti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Debajyoti is a Sanskrit name that means 'God's day, God's victory'. This name is rooted in Hinduism and is often given to a boy. The name conveys a sense of spiritual significance and wisdom, suggesting that the child will bring light and knowledge to those around them. Debajyoti is a name of great power and triumph, reflecting the victories that the child will achieve in life.
